record.field: # Nightly: clean temporary AP previews, then refresh every dashboard. cutoff = datetime.datetime.now() - datetime.timedelta(days=1) env['x_threshold_ap_preview'].sudo().search([ ('x_source', 'in', ['Dashboard', 'Dashboard drill-down']), ('create_date', '<', cutoff)]).unlink() dashboards = env['x_threshold_dashboard'].sudo().search([]) if dashboards: env.ref('threshold_report_dashboard.action_dashboard_refresh').sudo().with_context( active_model='x_threshold_dashboard', active_id=dashboards[0].id, active_ids=dashboards.ids).run()
